summary: The official Comune establishes local cadastral/urbanistic procedures, and the official Agenzia delle Entrate WMS exposes CP.CadastralParcel plus a bounded safe native ID/label/reference response. No polygon geometry was retrieved, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Italian discovery queries are recorded in city-1047-busto-arsizio.json. They identified the municipal Catasto e urbanistica and Carta Tecnica Comunale pages and the Agenzia delle Entrate cadastral Geoportale/WMS.
requestOutcomes: The Geoportale catalog page returned HTTP 200 and referenced its current viewer configuration. The direct geoportale WMS path led to a login-wall/redirect route. The public WMS capabilities returned HTTP 200 XML and named CP.CadastralParcel / Particelle. A bounded anonymous GetFeatureInfo request returned one safe native localId, label, and NationalCadastralReference but no geometry. A WFS capability attempt returned an XML SOAP fault.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [45.6040119276554, 8.8991164856004] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift was made.
The bounded GetFeatureInfo pixel/envelope was only a request attempt and is not evidence of exact-point hit, citywide coverage, or citywide absence.
No parcel polygon geometry, citywide extraction, or geometry-bearing API response was retained.
The municipal pages evidence local procedure/custody, not an anonymous parcel geometry API.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research completion only; it does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
safeFieldAllowlist: source layer and public service metadata
crs: EPSG:6706 declared by the live WMS capabilities; no feature geometry response retrieved.
